review_policy: Provisional assistant source/normative assessment, not owner approval or a conformance certificate. Source hashes bind the review. Functional contracts relate implementation to project models; translation from T.88 remains a separate review obligation. Feature worklists are not exhaustive requirement counts.

retention-wire-bit.name: retention_bit
retention-wire-bit.role: forward wire-byte order with least-significant-bit indexing within each flag byte

retention-values-match.name: retention_values_match
retention-values-match.role: every materialized retention flag equals its supplied wire bit

retention-unused-zero.name: unused_retention_bits_zero
retention-unused-zero.role: unused high bits in the final long-form flag byte are zero

short-count-valid.name: short_count_valid
short-count-valid.role: short count/retention field validity, including unused low-field bits

reference-width.name: reference_width
reference-width.role: one/two/four-byte reference width at inclusive segment-number boundaries

zeroed-storage.name: zeroed_storage
zeroed-storage.role: all stored bytes are zero; an initialization foundation, not caller timing or a complete first-typical-row proof

row-copy-result.name: row_copy_result
row-copy-result.role: complete stored destination-row copy from old source bytes with unchanged metadata and every other byte preserved

stored-pixel.name: stored_pixel
stored-pixel.role: MSB-first visible pixel view for the copied-row equality

row-copy-bounds.name: production_bitmap_row_copy_bounds
row-copy-bounds.role: derive checked row ranges and disjointness from valid bitmap storage

copied-row-pixels.name: production_generic_copied_row_pixels
copied-row-pixels.role: apply the proved byte-to-visible-pixel bridge to the exact executing wrapper

declared-count-matches-pages.name: declared_count_matches_pages
declared-count-matches-pages.role: a known returned declaration equals public page-vector cardinality

standalone-metadata.name: standalone_metadata
standalone-metadata.role: accepted metadata binds organization and count to the original header bytes and preserves count agreement

embedded-metadata.name: embedded_metadata
embedded-metadata.role: auxiliary project API shape for headerless streams, not an independent D.4.3 requirement

page-information-count.name: page_information_count
page-information-count.role: positive-page-associated PageInformation cardinality over a parsed-segment prefix

page-information-count-step.name: production_page_information_count_step
page-information-count-step.role: prove the parsed-prefix count recurrence at each collection step

header-colour.name: colour_regions
header-colour.role: declaration bit only, not colour decoding

context-valid.name: context_valid
context-valid.role: context bounds invariant, not reset-to-zero semantics

decoder-valid.name: decoder_valid
decoder-valid.role: normalized decoder-state invariant, not decoded-decision equivalence

requirements.title: Retention flags progress through wire bytes and low-to-high bits
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: Given supplied flag bytes, successful construction produces exactly count+1 entries and every entry equals the forward wire-bit model. The private append helper starts empty and preserves the relation for every completed entry.
assumptions: Interpretation follows the explicit 7.2.4 field definitions. The reversed 7.2.8 worked example conflicts; owner normative adjudication is pending.
The verified constructor discharges the private materializer's empty-vector precondition.
gaps: Complete the raw header-window/field-slice correspondence contract through the parser.
Review the worked-example discrepancy and complete retention lifecycle/caller obligations; helper equality is not full retention-policy conformance.

requirements.title: Unused retention positions are zero in short and long fields
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: The short-form guard and long-form final-byte guard accept exactly their field-validity models. Long-form byte ordering follows 7.2.4, not the conflicting worked example.
assumptions: Long-form byte count and supplied field boundaries remain caller obligations.
The 7.2.4 versus 7.2.8 inconsistency is explicit and not resolved by a dual-order heuristic.
gaps: Owner normative/model review and complete parser/caller correspondence remain pending.

requirements.title: Reference-number width follows inclusive segment-number boundaries
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: The helper returns the one/two/four-byte model at the 256 and 65536 inclusive boundaries.
assumptions: The model is a provisional translation of the field definition, not a complete parser proof.
gaps: Propagate width selection through raw field-consumption contracts and complete normative review.

requirements.title: A reference names a strictly lower-numbered segment
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: The scalar guard succeeds exactly when the referred number is below the current segment number.
assumptions: Reference existence, type, page association and lifetime require separate records.
gaps: Complete caller validation and normative review; this scalar comparison does not establish graph validity.

requirements.title: Read packed bits from the high bit of each byte before advancing to the next byte
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: Successful bounded reads equal the recursive bit-value model and advance by the requested count; errors preserve the cursor.
assumptions: Reader cursor is within input; input length is representable in bits; the model's extraction order is a reviewed translation of 5.4.1.

requirements.title: Interpret supported multi-byte integer primitives with the first byte most significant
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: The 16- and 32-bit primitive postconditions specify byte shifts and cursor advancement directly.
assumptions: Cursor validity is established by construction/prior reads; other field widths require their own mappings.

requirements.title: Recognize the fixed eight-byte standalone identifier
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: Acceptance/rejection follows the local header-validity model, which includes the exact signature predicate.
assumptions: The model's identification octets are a provisional, source-hash-bound normative capture.

requirements.title: Decode the standalone organization declaration
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: Returned organization equals the bit-0 model; this does not prove processing of either complete organization.
assumptions: The bit-to-enum model is a provisional translation of D.4.2.

requirements.title: Omit the declared count when the unknown-count flag is set
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: Optional count and consumed header length match the conditional field model.
assumptions: Header length is only the header extent, not complete-stream validity.

requirements.title: Expose the declaration that extended adaptive templates may occur
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: Declaration-bit decoding only, not cross-segment enforcement or extended-template raster semantics.
assumptions: The bit position is captured from the pinned D.4.2 edition.
gaps: Cross-segment use restrictions need a separate requirement and proof assessment.

requirements.title: Expose the declaration that coloured regions may occur
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: Header metadata only; this is not colour-decoder support.
assumptions: Colour decoding remains outside the approved project profile.
gaps: Colour rejection/profile handling needs its own policy trace.

requirements.title: Do not accept a standalone header with reserved flag bits set
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: Header validity includes a zero high nibble; typed error details are checked by tests rather than this postcondition.
assumptions: The acceptance predicate is the reviewed local syntactic model.

requirements.title: Decode the present page-count field as an unsigned four-byte value
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: Decoded metadata equals the unsigned big-endian field model, including numeric endpoints.
assumptions: No claim is made here that the declared count matches actual document pages.

requirements.title: A declared page count agrees with the document's pages
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: On success, standalone Decoder/DecoderContext slice inspection metadata preserves organization and declared count from the original header-byte model; any known declaration equals public page-vector length. Both parsers expose segment count and positive PageInformation cardinality against their returned parsed segments. Collection maintains prefix cardinality and finalization preserves order length. Embedded inspection's sequential/unknown-declaration shape is an auxiliary project API invariant, not an added D.4.3 interpretation.
assumptions: Header fields are linked to raw header bytes, but correspondence between body bytes and parsed segments remains unproved. Called helpers satisfy their verified contracts.
The private collection helper starts with empty vectors; its verified wrapper discharges those preconditions.
Cardinality does not establish page identity, lifecycle completeness or faithful raw-byte parsing.
gaps: Prove the raw body-byte parser to parsed-segment correspondence, including page identity/lifecycle semantics.
Reader I/O remains a reviewed boundary; decoded output-page metadata contracts are not strengthened by this tranche.
Finish normative/model review; successful-result contracts do not establish rejection completeness.

requirements.title: Select the context cardinality associated with each generic template
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: The helper returns the project's template-size model and a bounded bit count.
assumptions: Template-to-model capture needs normative review; cardinality does not prove geometric gathering.
gaps: Full template geometry and context-gathering equivalence need separate requirements.

requirements.title: Select the template-specific SLTP context, independently of relocated adaptive pixels
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: Lookup equality to the project gather-order model and index bounds only.
assumptions: Context gathering order is implementation-defined but must be consistent; the numeric indices are not universal normative constants.
gaps: Diagram-to-gather-order translation and callers' use at the required raster step need independent review/proofs.

requirements.title: Reset one probability context's state index and MPS sense to zero
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: Both reset fields are explicitly zero in the method's postcondition.
assumptions: The invariant model alone is weaker than the zero-field postcondition; call-site timing is outside this record.

requirements.title: Reset every selected probability context to zero
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: Every context in the selected output slice has zero state index and MPS; selected slice length is preserved. This closes the helper transformation gap, not reset call-site timing.
assumptions: The caller selects the intended context range and invokes reset at the required coding-procedure points; the helper needs no incoming context-validity precondition.

requirements.title: Produce the prescribed arithmetic decision and probability-state transition
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: The exposed postcondition bounds the signal and preserves decoder/context validity; it is not a full decision-recurrence model.
assumptions: Valid input decoder/context state and reviewed probability tables; the Annex-H-derived test is not proof of all decisions.
gaps: A functional postcondition must relate the returned decision and updated registers/context to the normative transition.

requirements.title: A typical row reproduces the preceding row under the specified edge convention
requirements.scope_of_formal_result: With valid bitmap storage and in-bounds row numbers, the same native slice-copy path executes and verifies. Success copies every stored destination-row byte from the old source row, preserves every other byte and metadata, and the generic wrapper explicitly proves equality of every visible destination pixel to the corresponding old source pixel. Successful blank construction and false-filled construction additionally prove zero stored bytes, without crediting first-row caller semantics.
assumptions: Bitmap storage validity and in-bounds rows are verified caller obligations, not assumptions on arbitrary raw bytes.
The pinned vstd specifications for split_at_mut and copy_from_slice, the Rust standard library and compiler remain trusted; their implementation is not proved here.
gaps: Propagate row semantics through caller loop invariants and the typical-prediction state transition/timing.
Propagate the proved blank zero-storage result into first-row caller/SLTP semantics to close the zero-edge rule; the first-row path still has executable rather than complete functional evidence.
Finish normative/model review and complete generic-region decomposition.
